purpose: Authoritative routing for repository, deployment and rollback state. Specialist case, evidence, procedural and reader-facing facts remain authoritative in their own controlled state files.

authority.current_repository_truth: Resolve refs/heads/main dynamically through GitHub or local git at execution time.
authority.current_deployment_truth: Resolve the latest successful GitHub Pages run for the relevant SHA and perform route-specific readback when material.
authority.historical_rollback_truth: Use ops/LAST_KNOWN_GOOD.json and ops/RELEASE_LEDGER.json; a formerly verified SHA is historical unless separately shown current.

specialist_state_routing.rule: This file controls repository, deployment and rollback truth only. The unitary state controls synchronized case, evidence, procedural and reader-routing facts. Neither layer substitutes for the other.

repository_observation.relationship_rule: The observed SHA must remain an ancestor of the checked-out commit. A live runtime report supersedes this last observation.

repository_inventory_observation.source: GitHub search API: repo:sbu001monterecco/por-derecho is:pr is:open
repository_inventory_observation.meaning: Observation only; always re-query before triage or merge decisions.

boundaries: This checked-in observation is not permanent current truth.
A successful Pages build is not the same as route-specific public-content verification.
Historical live verification remains valid as historical evidence but does not make that SHA current.
Open pull requests are candidate deltas, not repository truth.
Operational metadata does not establish any case allegation, procedural status or private-source conclusion.
